cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wipe the tyres. Rain is the exception, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' Initial it for Jo.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 sets the rain rule while volunteering tyre cleaning; A5 asks the current worker to endorse its future use.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 supplies the exception condition, and B4 makes its portability to Jo the remaining problem.

relationship.evidence: B2 grants entry with a condition; B4 protects the next worker discretion rather than inventing a distraction.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 staff change the reason for a signed precedent.

specificity.evidence: A1 names bicycle and cafe; B2 rain explains the concession without hidden staging.
